subject: Request for temporary capacity cushion and stepped-discount pricing
messages:
From: Sara Mills <sara@acmeretail.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-31T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Quick ask: short-term uplift for holiday test

Hey Dylan,

We're piloting a new product search experiment ahead of the holiday window and expect a short burst in generation traffic the week of Oct 18–24 (roughly 3–5M additional tokens/day). Can Redwood provide a short-term capacity cushion (temporary quota increase + higher rate limit) for that week?

Key questions:
- Lead time to enable and confirm headroom
- Incremental unit pricing for overrun tokens during the window
- Whether there's an option to prepay or take a short-term add-on with a blended rate (we'd prefer predictability over per-token volatility)

I've attached a recent usage export to help sizing. Looking for a quick proposal so I can brief procurement.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Mills
Product Ops — Acme Retail
attachments: usage_report_July.csv
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Mills <sara@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-31T11:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: short-term uplift for holiday test

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and the attachment. Quick read looks good. We can do a provisional uplift for the week you mentioned; a couple options below so procurement has something concrete:

Options (provisional):
1) Short-term headroom (7-day window) — 2x current quota unlocked for the week. Overage billed at standard pay-as-you-go rates + 15% surcharge. No PO required, can enable within 48 hours after signed acceptance.

2) Blended prepay add-on — Acme prepays for an estimated uplift volume and we offer a blended unit price (5–10% discount vs P&L overrun rate depending on commitment). Requires PO and simple SOW, enable within 3 business days of PO.

3) Stepped discount ladder (preferred for predictability) — tiered pricing: first incremental slab (up to +20% above baseline) at +10% unit price, next slab (up to +50%) at +5% unit price, with a one-time usage credit if PO executed before Oct 1. Enables with PO or short MOU.

If you want, Ben can draft a provisional ratecard and a short mutual action plan (2–3 bullets) for procurement. What matters most to you: speed to enable or invoice/PO terms?

—Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Procurement Team <procurement@acmeretail.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T08:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: short-term uplift for holiday test

Hi Ben / Dylan,

Procurement here — a few clarifying items before we can route a PO:
- Need a single-line SOW (1 paragraph) describing the uplift window, quantity estimate, and billing model.
- What is the max overrun unit price if actual usage exceeds the blended estimate?
- Invoice terms: can Redwood support net-60 for enterprise accounts?
- If you offer a one-time credit for early commitment, please state the exact credit amount and how it applies on the invoice.

Also attach the standard PO template so we can validate.

Thanks,
Procurement — Acme Retail
attachments: Acme_PO_template.docx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Mills <sara@acmeretail.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-01T14:40:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask: short-term uplift for holiday test — provisional ratecard attached

Hi Sara / Acme Procurement team,

Thanks — attached is a compact provisional ratecard and a one-paragraph SOW draft you can drop into your PO. Highlights below:

- Provisional SOW (single-line): Redwood will provision a temporary capacity uplift for Acme Retail between 2026-10-18 and 2026-10-24 to support experimental traffic, provisioning up to an additional 5M tokens/day above baseline; usage beyond provisioned uplift billed per agreed blended/add-on pricing.

- Stepped pricing proposal:
  • Slab A: up to +20% above baseline — blended unit price = baseline unit * 1.10
  • Slab B: +20% to +50% — blended unit price = baseline unit * 1.05
  • Beyond +50% — pay-as-you-go rate + 10% surcharge

- Early-commit credit: 10% one-time credit applied to the first invoice for uplift if PO received and SOW executed by 2026-10-01.
- Enablement lead time: 48 hours with MOU; 3 business days with PO and SOW.
- Invoice terms: Redwood can support net-60 for enterprise customers with an approved credit application; legal needs to sign off.

Attachments: Acme_provisional_ratecard_v2.pdf

If that looks OK I can turn this into a one-page MOU and a DocuSign envelope for signature.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales — Redwood Inference

1) Procurement will aim to get a PO to you by 2026-09-14 but we need net-60 on invoices. Please confirm legal can accept net-60 (or if we need a credit application).
2) Can you produce a 1-page mutual action plan (MOU) that lists key milestones (PO, enable, go-live, invoice) and owners? We prefer DocuSign for signatures.

If you can send the DocuSign and MOU today, I'll route to procurement and product for sign-off.

Cheers,
Sara
